rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a residential housing estate, especially a private development.

example.english: There’s a new coffee shop near the estate we live in.
example.traditional: 我哋住嗰個屋苑附近有間新咖啡店。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zyu6 go2 go3 uk1 jyun2 fu6 gan6 jau5 gaan1 san1 gaa3 fe1 dim3

rows.note: Use this instead when the housing estate is a public-housing estate.

example.english: A lot of residents in this public-housing estate exercise together.
example.traditional: 呢個屋邨入面有好多街坊一齊做運動。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 uk1 cyun1 jap6 min6 jau5 hou2 do1 gaai1 fong1 jat1 cai4 zou6 wan6 dung6

rows.note: Use this for an extensive privately owned country or manor estate, rather than a housing development.

example.english: They live in a large estate in France.
example.traditional: 佢哋一家人住喺法國一座大莊園入面。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 zyu6 hai2 faat3 gwok3 jat1 zo6 daai6 zong1 jyun4 jap6 min6
